advancedArguments.name: recHeadCode
advancedArguments.description: The recHeadCode of the grievance to fetch details for. Never ask the user for this and never accept a grievance name/title here - this tool has no search-by-name capability. If the user refers to the grievance by name (e.g. 'abcd'), first call getMyGrievanceHistory, match the user's wording against each result's name/comment fields, and take recHeadCode from the matched record.
